title: Concrete Gospel (Full-Length Edition)
description: Concrete Gospel, full length. V2's kick, snare, hats, bell, steel and 808 (V2's own hits, gains, effects and duck) with THRONE//VOLT, CATHEDRAL//ENGINE and HEAVEN//MASS.

tracks.description: V2's kick (IRON PULSE + skin knock + log click per hit). Bars 9-16 and 69-72 are V2's own; the verse, pressure, floor and chorus pockets are new.
V2's snare (TITANIUM CRACK + HEADLINER body + skin front per backbeat; crack-only ghosts).
V2's V12 GHOST TICK / OPEN CIRCUIT: footsteps, V2's hats, verse eighths, chorus triplets, verse-2 sixteenths.
The V12 CHROME STRIKE bell on F: it marks the sections.
The same bell gated short on C5/F5: V1's off-beat steel figure.
V2's 808 (Living Bass rack stem, new line) with V2's effects and duck: -14 dB under every kick, back in about 110 ms.
THRONE//VOLT (rack stem): both hooks, the tags, the cry, the last bend.
CATHEDRAL//ENGINE Great with its Nave: the dramatic responses and the last chords.
CATHEDRAL//ENGINE Swell with its Nave: the answers, the echoes, the floor, the bridge.
CATHEDRAL//ENGINE Pedal: only where there is no 808 (the bridge, the end).
HEAVEN//MASS basses (octavists on the last chord) with their Nave; 4 dB out of the way of each kick and snare.
HEAVEN//MASS tenors and altos with their Nave; 2.5 dB under each kick and snare; back 6 dB under the lead's calls.
HEAVEN//MASS sopranos, second sopranos and descant with their Nave; back 5 dB under the lead's calls.
